B_BASELINE_EXISTING_DIAGNOSTIC.policy: Do not require absolute zero. Track fixed projection, positive 3D area, no new true defect and no-regression or justified Human review.

D_SHARED_FEATURE_OFF_EDGE_ILLEGAL_CROSSI.policy: Hard fail, including faces with a shared vertex/edge.

E_NUMERICAL_PROXIMITY_ACTIVE_SET_WARNING.policy: Activate feature-aware checks, never automatically structural failure. Plane-extension sign changes require finite-feature membership.
